title: Checking an Ethernet Connection
summary: Verify that the wired network connection is physically secure before moving to software diagnostics.
why_it_matters: A loose, damaged, or disconnected Ethernet cable can prevent the computer from communicating with the router, switch, or wall connection.
what_to_check: Confirm the cable is firmly connected to the computer.
Confirm the other end is connected to the router, switch, or wall port.
Look for link lights near the Ethernet port.
Check the cable for visible damage or bent connectors.
common_indicators: The network icon shows a disconnected status.
Windows reports that the network cable is unplugged.
No link lights appear on the Ethernet port.
The connection works when a different cable is used.
